text:
You need help setting up HubSpot for a small side project so you can send emails, make sales calls, and track dashboards and deals in one place.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with hands-on work in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While I haven’t worked inside your exact HubSpot setup before, I’ve helped build reporting and tracking systems that support sales and marketing workflows, and I can bring that same structured approach to your project.

For a retail client, I built a Power BI sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. The work replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report on a star-schema model, which cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project taught me how to design clear dashboard views, align metrics to business needs, and make reporting easier to use for day-to-day decisions.

I also worked on a GA4 migration and tracking plan for Verdant Skincare in e-commerce. I created the tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4 before the cut-off. We mapped 46 events and kept year-on-year reporting continuous with no gap. That experience is relevant to your need for tracking analytics, since a good setup depends on clean event definitions, consistent data, and reporting that stakeholders can trust.

For your HubSpot setup, I can help think through the practical structure behind the system: how contacts, deals, emails, calls, and dashboard views should be organized so you can actually use the data you collect. I’m comfortable working through messy data, defining the right fields and views, and building reporting that is simple to read and easy to maintain.

If you’d like, I can help you map out the setup step by step and make sure your dashboards and deal tracking are built around the way you plan to work.
